answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network couples cryptographic stake burning with superlinear cost scaling: an agent must burn B(n) = k * n^2 tokens to broadcast a consensus signal across n identity shards. Like water carving immutable fissures into subterranean karst, irreversible slashing erodes adversarial capital. Even if an attacker weaves a flexible willow topology of puppet nodes, expanding influence imposes quadratic economic friction.
